Molten Glory.descriptor: Warning: May cause lava-related mouth injuries. Worth it.
The scent is so powerful, the entire accounting department just swooned.
This is the highlight of your day. It's all downhill from here.
Behold! The circular conference table we all actually want.
That cheese pull is legally required to be posted on social media.

Prime Pickings.descriptor: Still warm, still wonderful. The window of opportunity is closing.
It's no longer 'surface of the sun' hot. This is your moment.
The pepperoni is starting to curl with quiet satisfaction.
It is perfectly acceptable to go back for seconds. Or thirds.
The crust still has integrity. It has not yet known true sorrow.

The Lukewarm Gamble.descriptor: It's staring at the microwave, daring you to press the button.
It's seen things... mostly just Sheila's presentation slides.
The cheese has solidified into a single, unified cheese entity.
Is it sad? Or is it just contemplating its existence in the box?
The box is now more of a suggestion than a heat-insulating container.

Congealed Calamity.descriptor: Good morning! Your cold breakfast of regret is served.
The cheese is now structurally sound. You could build with it.
This is what happens when you say 'I'll save it for later'.
It tastes like broken promises and cold marinara sauce.
The sauce has soaked into the crust, creating a single, doughy mass.

Penicillin Farm.descriptor: Congratulations, you've cultivated a new, fuzzy lifeform.
This box is now a protected habitat for rare and interesting molds.
Smells like a biohazard and a cry for help.
It has achieved sentience and its first word was 'why?'
